name: Omnitype
oneLine: Voice dictation for Windows with LLM-powered voice actions.
problem: Dictation turns speech into text but cannot act on it.
built: A Rust desktop app for Windows that converts speech to text and runs LLM-driven actions on it. Version 0.1.0, covered by unit tests.
decisions: The speech-to-text path works on its own; LLM actions are layered on top of it.
